<title level="1" right="Action">[Breach](/Actions.aspx?ID=2795) <actions string="Two Actions" /></title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 95

</column>

---

The orca [Swims](/Actions.aspx?ID=2381) up to its swim Speed, then [Leaps](/Actions.aspx?ID=2298) vertically out of the water up to 25 feet in the air, making a Strike against a creature at any point during the jump (this lets it attack a creature within 30 feet of the water’s surface). After the Strike, the orca splashes back down into the water.
